one_line: AI sector sees massive funding, Anthropic expands operations, new benchmarks launch, and enterprise tools get major updates.

themes.title: AI funding surge worldwide
themes.text: Major investors poured billions into AI firms, from Saudi Aramco’s $2.6 billion stake in Humain to Hex Technologies’ $100 million Series D and multiple Series A/B rounds for Vera Health, Casap, Bites, Tutor Intelligence, and Oracle’s $20 billion stock‑bond offering.

stories.headline: Saudi Aramco buys 49% of AI startup Humain, adds $2.6 billion cash
Hex Technologies raises $100 million Series D, launches Hex 4.0 for AI agents
Vera Health raises $28.5 million Series A to expand AI-powered clinical search platform
Casap raises $56 million Series B to expand AI dispute and fraud tools for banks
Bites raises $40 million Series A to expand AI‑driven frontline training platform
Tutor Intelligence raises $75 million Series B to expand robot model training and deployments
Oracle to raise $20 billion via stock and bond sales for AI data centers

themes.title: Anthropic expands and regulates
themes.text: Anthropic added a rule to block Claude Code from cloning existing games, disclosed $895.4 billion in compute commitments, and announced a ¥552.9 bn raise from Japanese investors for its U.S. IPO.

stories.headline: Anthropic adds rule to stop Claude Code from cloning existing video games
Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
Anthropic to raise up to ¥552.9 bn ($3.5 bn) from Japanese investors in US IPO

themes.title: New AI benchmarks released
themes.text: SemiAnalysis introduced the GDPx benchmark where Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 led with 12% score; OpenAI launched LifeVal for everyday assistance tasks; researchers used GPT‑6 Astra to edit 0.016% of Qwen3.5‑0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold.

stories.headline: SemiAnalysis releases GDPx benchmark; Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 scores 12%
OpenAI launches LifeVal benchmark for AI assistance with everyday tasks
GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold

themes.title: Enterprise AI tools updated
themes.text: xAI deployed Data Bot for SpaceX data queries, Qodo integrated company knowledge into Codex for pre‑pull‑request reviews, OpenAI merged Chat and Work tabs in its desktop app, and Elon Musk limited Grok Bot usage due to high costs.

stories.headline: xAI launches Data Bot, a team AI assistant for data queries at SpaceX
Qodo adds company knowledge to Codex for pre‑pull‑request code review
OpenAI to merge Chat and Work tabs in ChatGPT desktop app for select users
Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot usage limits citing unsustainably high costs
